apps.title: Duck War
apps.summary:
Get ready for the ultimate battle game in Duck War!

Build your duck army, collect powerful troops, and lead them into battle! Choose the right path, grow your squad, and use smart strategies to defeat your enemies.

How to play
- Build Your Duck Army: Collect more ducks and fill your army slots. The bigger your squad, the stronger your force!
- Choose Your Path: Make the right moves along the road. Pick up bonuses, grow your army, and prepare your ducks for the battle ahead.
- Battle & Conquer: Send your duck army into exciting battles! Use your numbers and strategy to defeat enemy squads and win the fight.
- Upgrade & Get Stronger: Earn coins from every victory and use them to expand your army and power up your ducks.

Why You'll Love Duck War
- Simple, Fun Gameplay: Easy-to-understand controls and straightforward mechanics make it easy to jump in and start playing, while every battle keeps you engaged.
- Exciting Army Growth: Watch your duck squad grow as you collect more soldiers and build up a powerful army before each battle.
- Challenging Choices: Choose your path carefully and make the right moves to build the strongest squad possible.
- Satisfying Battles: See your duck army charge into battle with fun animations and satisfying battle effects.
- Colorful Visuals: Enjoy a bright, playful world filled with charming ducks, colorful environments, and lively animations.

Build your army. Choose your path. Win the war!

Think you can lead the strongest duck army? Jump into Duck War and start your battle!

apps.title: Magic Quiz: Trivia Games
apps.developer: Quiz & Trivia Games by Mno Go Apps
apps.summary:
Magic Quiz – Let Curiosity Work Its Magic!

What if every question could reveal something unexpected?

Welcome to Magic Quiz, a trivia game that turns general knowledge into a collection of delightful discoveries. Choose an answer, uncover a fascinating fact, and let each question lead you to something new.

Magic Quiz is made for curious minds that enjoy learning without lessons or complicated rules. Every round brings a fresh mix of trivia questions inspired by the world around us. Some answers may feel familiar, while others can completely change the way you see an ordinary subject.

WHY PLAY MAGIC QUIZ?

• Discover interesting facts through simple question-and-answer gameplay
• Explore a rich variety of general knowledge topics
• Encounter familiar subjects and unexpected trivia
• Enjoy an elegant liquid-glass visual style
• Move through questions at a comfortable pace
• Use helpful hints when you need a touch of magic
• Return anytime for another quick quiz or a longer trivia session

A LITTLE MAGIC IN EVERY ANSWER

Magic Quiz is not about memorizing textbooks. It is about the spark of finding out why an answer is right, remembering a fact you have not thought about in years, or discovering something completely new.

The rules are simple, but the questions can lead anywhere. One quiz may take you into ancient history, the next into outer space, famous movies, unusual animals, or curious details from everyday life.

Whether you have a few free minutes or feel like exploring question after question, Magic Quiz makes it easy to follow your curiosity. Its clean, shimmering design keeps the focus on the most rewarding part of any quiz game: the moment an answer becomes a discovery.

There is always another curious question waiting to reveal its secret.

Download Magic Quiz and discover what your curiosity will uncover next!

Gently brush off all the shiny crystals covering the magical Fluvsies egg. Once it’s ready, tap it to hatch the egg and meet a new virtual pet - Mochi.

apps.title: Isles of Kings
apps.summary:
Brave adventurers! Shipwrecked on a mist-shrouded island filled with bizarre creatures and deadly plants. Build tools ➔ Grow population ➔ Defend territory in this unique survival strategy game!

【 Core Features】
▷ Dual Gameplay: City-building meets survival mechanics (Hunger/Campfire/Disease system)
▷ Dynamic Resource Chain: 50+ craftable tools & 20+ production buildings (Workshop→Sawmill→Foundry)
▷ Workforce Management: Assign 8 types of specialists (Lumberjack/Guard/Cook)
▷ Tactical Defense: Build watchtowers & train archers to fight fog monsters
▷ Smart Automation: 12h offline progress & blueprint system
▷ 3D Optimization: Smooth performance on mid-range devices

【Survival Rules】
• Keep campfire burning (Mist=Health Drain)
• No nighttime operations (3x danger)
• Balance food/Lumber/medicine production

【Strategic Gameplay】

Resource Acquisition

On this mysterious island, resources are scarce and precious, with every step filled with challenges. Wild animals, natural disasters, and other survivors are all competing for the limited resources available on the island… Only by using wisdom and courage can you survive in this unknown land and establish your own shelter!

Territory Establishment

In this desolate land, compete with players worldwide for control of territories! Utilize clever strategies and teamwork to expand your influence and become the true ruler of the island!

Alliance Formation

Surviving alone is difficult; seek like-minded partners to form a powerful alliance. Together, face the threats posed by hostile survivors and nature, and collectively carve out a space for survival!

Recruit Survivors

Survivors with unique skills are waiting for your call! By recruiting and nurturing different characters, enhance your team's survival and combat capabilities, allowing your group to stand out in this survival adventure!

Challenge Confrontation

Showcase your strategic wisdom, optimize team composition, and leverage each survivor's strengths to tackle the various challenges of wilderness survival. Compete against other players to seize resources and glory, becoming a legend on the island!

Technology Development

On this island, the spark of modern technology has nearly extinguished and urgently needs to be rebuilt. Through exploration, collection, and research, rediscover lost technologies, improve the living environment, and help you find hope and vitality in adversity!


▶︎ Ready for strategic colony management? Download now for FREE!

Hack and slash your way through a vibrant fantasy world, battling epic bosses and hundreds of different enemies along the way. Crush waves of skeletons, goblins, and ogres – then face off against fearsome dragons, colossal giants, deadly demons, and much more.

Explore a vast world and discover a huge variety of stunning locations and enemies. Craft your perfect team: summon legendary Invokers and powerful Titans and experience the most exciting Action RPG combat on mobile – this is a true AAA mobile game. Adventure across tons of levels and beat huge dungeon bosses to win the best loot.

COLLECT INVOKERS & TITANS

Summon over a hundred Invokers from a variety of different Factions and customize your fantasy team: play as orcs, elves, humans – or someone a little more furry. And that's not all – summon powerful Titans and bind them to your Invokers to call upon legendary power.

INVOKE TITANS

When the time's right, unleash the ultimate power – Invoke a Titan and transform into a super powered fantasy creature to take down anything that stands in your way.

FIGHT EPIC BOSS BATTLES

Face off against classic monsters and bosses and experience the best boss battles on mobile! Go to war against the terrifying Corrupted Dragon, the cold-hearted Ice Queen, the merciless Demon Lord, and many more – in the best Action MMORPG battles around.

FAST-PACED ACTION COMBAT

Don't waste time taking turns – Invokers: Titan Legacy is all-action, all the time. Invokers takes all the tactics and strategy of turn-based battle RPGs, but boosts the excitement to a new level with fast, flashy, action gameplay.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR TEAM

With billions of different team combinations and ways to develop your Invokers, you can play exactly how you want. Equip your team with powerful relics, then upgrade their skills to fit your strategy and tactics – bring deadly attackers, tough tanks, helpful healers, powerful sorcerers, or whatever you need to take down your next target.

CLIMB THE SPIRES

Craft the perfect strategy and build your teams to climb the towers to glory. Each legendary elemental tower requires a fully custom team. Master the elements and claim your victory.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Play how you want – whenever, wherever. Take full control of every Invoker, every skill, and every ability – or play on Auto mode to kick back, relax, and watch your awesome team do their thing.

And no internet, no problem. You can play Invokers offline – no matter where you are in the world. On a plane? At the bottom of the sea? Upgrade your experience with non-stop action-packed Invokers battles.

STUNNING 3D GRAPHICS

From the gorgeous, fully-animated 3D characters to the richly detailed, vibrant biomes, Invokers offers a vivid world you can immerse yourself in. And with thousands of unique skill animations and effects, action RPG combat has never looked more exciting.

EXPLORE A DEEP FANTASY WORLD

Get to know every Invoker in Amara, with fully fleshed out lore and bios for every single character – along with an expansive world map to discover. The world of Invokers is deep, complex, and rich with story.

apps.title: Armor Sandbox
apps.summary:
Armor Sandbox is a 2D impact physics playground. Pick something to shoot, pick something to shoot at, and watch what actually happens.

Nothing here is a canned animation. Every plate, every projectile and every fragment is made of particles that carry real material properties: density, strength, toughness, melting point, heat capacity. Deformation, fracture, spalling, heat, fire and detonation all come from those numbers. Swap the steel for glass and it shatters instead of denting, because glass is brittle, not because somebody drew a shatter effect.

WHAT IS IN IT

• 110+ materials: steels, aluminium alloys, tungsten, uranium, ceramics and glass, concrete and stone, wood, rubber, water, fuel, explosives, nuclear materials and working electrical parts
• 70 projectiles: pistol and rifle rounds, APFSDS long rods, shaped charges, HESH, railgun slugs and three detailed missiles
• 90+ targets: plates, layered armour, deep blocks, ballistic gelatin, bunkers and circuits
• 36 vehicle cutaways: T-34-85, Tiger I, Panther, Sherman, IS-2, T-55, M103, T-72 with and without reactive armour, M1A2 Abrams, Leopard 2A6, Challenger 2, BMP-1, M113 and more, plus cars, trucks, a bus, a tractor, a fighter jet and attack helicopters, each with its real armour, ammunition, fuel and engine inside
• 60+ ready-made experiments, from a ricochet to a chain of nuclear devices

MAKE YOUR OWN

Paint projectiles and targets pixel by pixel, choosing the material of every pixel. Mirror, outline, replace, snap to a grid. Save them to your library and share a design with a friend, or with the community Workshop, as a single small file.

TUNE THE MATERIALS

Change how strong, dense, hot or explosive any material is, and every simulation follows your numbers.

WIRE IT UP

Batteries, capacitors, switches, sensors, delay lines, detonators. Current goes only where you drew a path: an insulated wire along steel leaves the steel dead, bare copper makes the whole plate live. Pressure plates, tripwires, magnetic and proximity sensors, photocells, radio receivers and high-voltage sparks that jump the air.

HEAR IT, RECORD IT

Impacts, explosions, fire and projectiles flying past all sound like the material and the speed. Record your shots as video and share them.

IT RUNS ON A PHONE

The physics core runs in a background thread, so the screen keeps up while the simulation works. Quality follows your device, from 18,000 particles up to a million.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS, NO TRACKING

Nothing you build leaves your device unless you export it yourself.

FREE, AND FULL

Watching is free. Every built-in experiment runs in full, explosives, nuclear devices and circuits included, and so does every vehicle and every material a preset uses. Importing a design someone sent you is free too.

The full version is for making things: painting with energetic, nuclear and electrical materials, editing the properties of every material, a library without the five-per-kind limit, exporting your designs, and the Extreme and Maximum quality levels. One payment, no subscription, no ads either way.

Available in English, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish and Chinese.

Formerly Armor Simulation.

Monster Hunter Outlanders is a Monster Hunter exploration hunting action game on mobile, officially licensed by CAPCOM and developed by TiMi Studio Group. The game preserves the classic weapons and hunting experience the IP is known for, while introducing a brand-new world, original Adventurers, Buddies, and exclusive new Monsters.

① Hunt & Explore in the Living Aesoland.
A new adventure awaits on your phone! Built for mobile play, with portable controls that allow you to dive into the action instantly!

② Epic Elder Dragons & Exclusive Radiant Species, Only in Monster Hunter Outlanders.
Wrapped in a dazzling radiance, the Elder Dragon Ruger Aidal descends like a blazing sun!
Shaped by the ever-changing environment, Radiant Monsters are here to bring new adventures and challenges!

③ No Quest is Too Great, Team Up Anytime!
Explore the vast field solo, or rally your friends with a single tap to form a 4-player hunting squad. No matter when or where, as long as you've got companions by your side, no monster is too fearsome to face!

④ Original Adventurers & Classic Weapons, Unleash All-new Hunting Arts
The eight classic weapon types are here: Great Sword, Long Sword, Dual Blades, Hammer, Lance, Charge Blade, Heavy Bowgun, and Bow. Each weapon forms a unique combination with Adventurers, preserving the core hunting experience while unlocking all-new Follow-up moves! More weapons will join the hunt in future updates.

⑤ Meet New Buddies.
Palico, Rutaco, and Trillan—three Buddies, each with their own unique personality—will join you on the hunt, adding color to your adventure through a wealth of events and happenings.

⑥ Born For Mobile.
Faithful recreations of the series' classic weapons and hunting gameplay, deeply optimized for mobile devices to deliver a smoother, more freeform experience—hunt wherever, whenever!

Happy Hunting!

apps.title: Sector Defense: Roguelike TD
apps.summary:
One soldier. One drone. An alien swarm at the gates.

Sector Defense is a sci-fi tower defense game built around a hero, a combat drone, and the base they must protect. Pick roguelike skills, upgrade your gear, and turn a small fighting force into a wall of firepower.

🛡️ HOLD THE LINE

The aliens are closing in. Stand your ground as waves push toward your base, and shape your tower defense strategy around stopping them before they break through. Your position stays fixed, but your options grow as the battle unfolds.

This is tower defense at close quarters: the next wave is coming down the same battlefield you are fighting to hold. A strong start helps, but survival depends on the choices that follow. Build a defense that can withstand the pressure, then push back against the swarm.

🎯 ONE HERO. ONE COMBAT DRONE.

Your armored soldier is not the only star of the battle. Your combat drone adds its firepower. Both defend your base, giving this alien tower defense game a clear focus: keep your small team strong enough to stop a much larger threat.

Upgrade your equipment and see how your hero and drone fit into your evolving build. Their strength is not just in the weapons they carry, but in the abilities you choose to support them. Build your base defense around this fighting pair and keep the alien bugs away from the gates.

🃏 CHOOSE SKILLS. CHANGE THE BATTLE.

Roguelike tower defense puts decisions in your hands.

- Pick from the skill cards offered during a run, combine abilities, and develop a build that answers the pressure on your base.
- Each selection helps you craft your strategy. The cards offer a limited choice, so you cannot take everything at once.
- Decide which option adds the most to your current setup instead of chasing power that does not fit.

Do you strengthen an ability you already rely on or choose something different? Experiment with skill combinations and watch how they affect the fight. These roguelike decisions give tower defense a new layer of strategy: you are shaping your next answer to the alien horde, one choice at a time.

🔧 UPGRADE BEYOND THE CURRENT FIGHT

In-battle skills shape your current run. Equipment upgrades prepare you for the battles ahead. Keep those two layers working together: develop your roguelike build in combat, then upgrade your gear to strengthen your starting position.

Your tower defense progression is about turning what you learn into a stronger setup. Upgrade your equipment and hammer the alien swarm with greater firepower. Each upgrade gives you more strength to bring back to tower defense battles, while your next set of skill choices determines how you use it.

👾 FACE THE THREAT BEHIND THE SWARM

Alien bosses bring the war to your gates. The enemy is now tougher, and the skills that helped with earlier waves may not be enough. Bring your weapons and abilities together for the moment your defense needs them most.

Boss battles give your tower defense upgrades a purpose beyond bigger numbers. Can your setup withstand the attack, or does it need a different combination? Take what you learn into the next fight and give your hero a better chance of survival when the next boss arrives.

🔥 MAKE YOUR STAND

A hero, a drone, and your choices stand between the alien invasion and your base. Combine roguelike decisions with tower defense progression, strengthen your base defense, and fight for survival. Hold the line, one wave at a time.

apps.title: Dragonbound: Wings of Magic
apps.summary:
Step into the Dragon Knight Academy, master powerful magic, and hatch a dragon all your own. Feed it, train it, and watch it evolve into the partner who fights by your side.

But this isn't your first time here. On your last journey, the Chaos surge twisted your most trusted dragon into something monstrous. Now you've awoken, back on the very day you first met.

Relearn your magic. Raise your dragon anew. Ride into battle on dragonback, uncover the truth behind the corruption, and push back the Chaos with your allies — to change the future.

【Choose Your Class, Forge Your Style】
Battle shifts in an instant, and so can you. Swap class roles on the fly, mix weapons and skills, and adapt from brutal melee to ranged magic whenever the fight demands it.

【Take to the Skies】
Mount your dragon and carry the battle into the air. Hunt down flying targets, dodge incoming fire, and unleash coordinated aerial strikes with your dragon at your side.

【Hunt the Demon Dragon】
A colossal Demon Dragon, twisted by Chaos, is awakening. Rally your party, read its patterns, strike its weak points, and focus your fire to bring down the beast in the heat of its fury.

【Build Your Home, Find Your Crew】
Meet allies from across the realm and explore the Heimdall Continent together. Build a magical home of your own — a warm base camp to return to before every new journey.

apps.title: Gabby's Dollhouse NETFLIX
apps.summary:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED. AD-FREE, UNLIMITED ACCESS FOR NETFLIX MEMBERS.

Join Gabby and her tiny cat pals for interactive fun in this kids' game full of sprinkles and sparkles. Explore, play and create in every room!

Discover the magic of "Gabby's Dollhouse." With eight cat-tastic, colorful rooms full of fun and surprises, there's so much to do in this a-meow-zing app. Check the Meow Meow Mailbox for daily deliveries, snap some pics with the Kitty Cam and play with Gabby, Pandy Paws and the Gabby Cats from the hit DreamWorks show. It's time to get tiny!

• KITCHEN: Cook, bake, and have a Sprinkle Party with Cakey Cat. Try out the ice cream machine and make tasty treats.

• MUSIC ROOM: Tinker with tons of instruments, make music and boogie down with DJ Catnip!

• BATHROOM: Create your own potions, color Gabby's hair and do some Spa Science with MerCat.

• BEDROOM: Pick out new outfits for Gabby, then cuddle up with Pillow Cat for a cozy cat nap.

• PLAYROOM: Hit the race track with Carlita, play games, build with blocks or try out the zip line!

• CRAFT ROOM: Tinker with colorful crafting supplies with Baby Box Cat and make your own robot cat.

• FAIRY TAIL GARDEN: Grow a garden with Kitty Fairy, have a picnic and visit the treehouse in the cotton candy tree.

• PARTY ROOM: Calling all party cats! Get ready to decorate, dance and celebrate with Marty the Party Cat!

FEATURES

• Explore eight unique Dollhouse rooms designed for endless hours of pretend play.

• Play with favorite "Gabby's Dollhouse" characters, including Gabby, Pandy Paws, CatRat, MerCat, Cakey Cat, Kitty Fairy and more.

• Get special items delivered daily in the Meow Meow Mailbox.

• Snap pics with the Kitty Cam and try out Gabby-themed frames.

• Play offline and on the go without WiFi.

• Perfect for toddlers or kids in preschool and kindergarten.

• No in-game ads means no interruptions.

- Created by Sago Mini.

An anime-style collectible RPG packed with immersive storytelling and dynamic cinematic presentation — Make Drama!

A deeply immersive world that changes according to your choices, filled with hidden stories waiting to be uncovered!

KEEP EXPLORING

apps.title: Animal Makeover ASMR MiniGames
apps.summary:
Give every character a fresh new look in Animal Makeover ASMR MiniGames.

Explore a playful collection of hands-on skincare, beauty, fashion and styling activities where every level brings a different challenge. Clean up messy details, use treatment tools, try new colors and accessories, then finish each transformation with a three-pose photo shoot.

Clean, Care and Treat

Start with the alligator and work through a dental care routine that includes brace removal, water flossing, bone and lesion removal, teeth cleaning and whitening. Other levels focus on gentler skincare tasks, such as washing away dirt, removing acne or unwanted piercings, applying moisturizer and using a face mask before moving on to the final look.

Hair, Color and Salon Fun

The cat level turns into a complete hair salon session. Remove debris, shampoo and scrub the fur, towel dry it, add colorful dye streaks and use the styling machine to create a new style. The husky also gets hair cutting and styling choices, while the parrot brings trimming, drying and detailed nose work with polishing, cream and color.

Makeover Mini Games

Every animal makeover brings a different routine. Trim the watermelon vines, wipe and moisturize the skin, add eye lenses, lipstick, makeup and face painting, then choose clothes for the final reveal.

The parrot can be finished with masks, eyebrow color, body spray, jewelry, eyewear, earrings and an outfit, giving each character its own personality.

Dress Up and Finish

Complete the experience with dress up choices, headbands, lipstick, makeup, hairstyles, clothes and accessories. Each level ends with three posed photos so you can see the finished result from different angles.

Game Features

• ASMR mini games with varied beauty and pet care activities
• Dental, skincare and salon-inspired treatment tools
• Hair styling, color, makeup and dress up choices
• Different animals, outfits and accessory combinations
• Three posed photos after every completed level

Try each animal makeover routine, discover new tools and enjoy a different final look with every character.

apps.title: Drunkn Bar Fight Mobile
apps.summary:
Welcome to the official mobile version of Drunkn Bar Fight VR!

The place is packed, the music is loud, and everybody is in the mood for a brawl. Grab whatever is nearby and get ready for crazy chaos that fits right in your pocket.

YOUR PERSONAL BRAWL SIMULATOR
Think of it as a bar simulator where nothing makes sense and everything is funny. You punch, kick, grab and throw, and the crowd reacts in the most dramatic way possible. Every fight is a tiny story with ragdoll physics, flying chairs and shocked faces.

GRAB IT, THROW IT
Almost anything you see can become a weapon. Bottles, stools, chairs and other bar stuff are all fair game. Pick something up, take aim and send it across the room. You can even throw people. Yes, really!

GAME FEATURES
✪ Funny ragdoll physics for silly hit reactions
✪ Bottles, chairs, stools and more to use as weapons
✪ Level progression, rewards and character customization
✪ Punch, grab, throw and kick your way through the night
✪ Many chaotic places to explore and smash
✪ Hilarious bar fights with wacky characters
✪ Simple touch controls made for mobile
✪ A physics sandbox with no boring moments
✪ Multiplayer fun for you and your friends

RAGDOLL PHYSICS AT WORK
Every hit sends someone flying in a floppy, wobbly way. Thanks to ragdoll physics, no two fights play out the same. A light shove can turn into a spinning flight. A big swing can leave a surprised guy lying on a table. That is ragdoll comedy in action.

A PLAYGROUND FOR TROUBLEMAKERS
Every location is a playground made for smashing, tossing and tumbling. Look around, pick a target and make a mess. Bars, parties, streets and supermarkets are all waiting for you.

Think of the game as a physics sandbox where you decide how the night goes. Want to kick a stool across the room? Go ahead. Want to toss a bottle at the wall? Sure. This sandbox rewards curiosity and a big sense of humor.

BRING YOUR FRIENDS
Chaos is better with a crew. Multiplayer fights turn into laughing fits when your buddy gets launched by a flying chair. Team up, plan a sneaky attack or just run around and cause trouble.

QUICK SESSIONS, BIG LAUGHS
Got ten minutes? Jump in, start a brawl, and see how much damage you can cause before last call. It is a perfect way to kick back after a long day and let off some steam.

Let's make some noise!
Step into a playground where the rules are optional. Invite your friends, pick up a bottle and kick off the party. Bring a buddy to every multiplayer match and share the laughs. It is a fun simulator with one big question: how much chaos can you cause?

Download Drunkn Bar Fight now, step into the chaos, and win your next fight today!

apps.title: Score Royale
apps.summary:
Score Royale turns a standard 52-card deck into a strategy board. Lay your cards out across five tracks, complete classic card combinations, and settle each track for points. Every card you place changes what the next one is worth.

Each round deals you a full deck and five open tracks. A track holds up to five cards and settles the moment it is full, so the order you play matters as much as the cards you keep. Take the safe pairing, or set a card aside in the swap area and reach for a stronger combination.

Five tracks, five spaces each — arrange all 52 cards and settle every track
Classic card combinations, from a simple pair up to the strongest five-card run
Stacked multipliers — the tougher the combination, the higher the score
Swap area to set a card aside and rebuild your layout
Time and heart rewards added to your final result
Four rooms with different deck counts, timers and target scores
Daily challenges and match history to follow your progress
A guided tutorial covering every combination and multiplier

The four rooms each play differently. Bronze gives you room to learn, Silver and Gold tighten the clock, and Diamond asks for the highest target score of all with the least time to reach it. Beat a room's target score and it stays unlocked. The round also ends when your hearts run out or the last card is played.

Start as a guest in seconds, or register with an email address to carry your progress between devices. If your hearts run out or the clock beats you, one optional rewarded ad lets you continue, once per round.

Score Royale is a single-player card strategy game. In-game coins are earned through gameplay only and cannot be purchased or exchanged.

apps.title: MapTap.gg
apps.summary:
MapTap is a daily geography game. Every day you get five places tied to real events from that exact date, and the game is to find each one on a 3D globe. Tap where you think it is. The closer you land, the higher you score. Then you read what actually happened there: a shipwreck, an invention that failed twice before it worked, a border that moved overnight, someone nobody has heard of who changed something you use every day.

It takes about 2 minutes to play. Tomorrow there are five more, and five more the day after that. Keep a streak alive, see how your score sits against everyone else who played that day, or just against players near you. When 2 minutes is not enough, there is a lot more globe. Practice maps run from plain drills to journeys you retrace one stop at a time: Magellan's expedition, Darwin's voyage on the Beagle, Nellie Bly's race around the world, Ibn Battuta's travels. Find the Flag is a daily of its own. Gauntlet is a timed run at a set of locations everybody gets on the same day. Frontier is a survival run where one bad guess ends it. Versus puts you head to head with another player over five locations, with a rating that follows you around. Flashcards drill a map until it sticks.

There are hundreds of achievements to discover. You can build maps for other players, and play other players' maps!

MapTap plays in 12 languages. MapTap+ is an optional subscription that adds sharper satellite detail on the globe, the full run of practice maps, private groups to play alongside friends, the last 90 days of games you missed, drill sets you build yourself, and the curated Best of MapTap collection.

The daily game is free, and there are no ads in it anywhere, for anyone, ever.

MapTap is a daily geography game. Every day you get five places tied to real events from that exact date, and the game is to find each one on a 3D globe. Tap where you think it is. The closer you land, the higher you score. Then you read what actually happened there: a shipwreck, an invention that failed twice before it worked, a border that moved overnight, someone nobody has heard of who changed something you use every day. 

It takes about 2 minutes to play. Tomorrow there are five more, and five more the day after that. Keep a streak alive, see how your score sits against everyone else who played that day, or just against players near you. When 2 minutes is not enough, there is a lot more globe. Practice maps run from plain drills to journeys you retrace one stop at a time: Magellan's expedition, Darwin's voyage on the Beagle, Nellie Bly's race around the world, Ibn Battuta's travels. Find the Flag is a daily of its own. Gauntlet is a timed run at a set of locations everybody gets on the same day. Frontier is a survival run where one bad guess ends it. Versus puts you head to head with another player over five locations, with a rating that follows you around. Flashcards drill a map until it sticks. 

There are hundreds of achievements to discover. You can build maps for other players, and play other players' maps! 

MapTap plays in 12 languages. MapTap+ is an optional subscription that adds sharper satellite detail on the globe, the full run of practice maps, private groups to play alongside friends, the last 90 days of games you missed, drill sets you build yourself, and the curated Best of MapTap collection. 

The daily game is free, and there are no ads in it anywhere, for anyone, ever.

apps.summary:
Riley Ashford and her brother Jake are treasure hunters who are looking for an adventure deep within the Bermuda Triangle. Along with their pilot, Marcus Reed, they venture into the unknown — but a powerful magnetic storm suddenly strikes their helicopter.

A basic alarm can be too easy to ignore. One tap can end the sound, but it does not always get you out of bed. Morning Arrows helps change that by adding an optional arrow-based task before the alarm stops.

Morning Arrows is built to be easy to use every day while giving you more control over how strong or active your wake-up routine should feel.

- Set multiple alarms for different parts of your day
- Use one-time alarms or repeat by weekday
- Choose ringtone and vibration settings
- Stop alarms normally or with an arrow task
- Use different arrow task levels depending on your routine
- Manage everything in a clear, simple layout

Why people use it
- Standard alarms are too easy to dismiss
- Snoozing turns into oversleeping
- A small task helps them wake up more fully
- They want a stronger alarm without a confusing setup
✅ If you need something more effective than a basic alarm clock, Morning Arrows gives you a more active way to wake up and stay on schedule.

apps.summary:
🔍 What do some words have in common that others simply do not?

That question is at the heart of every puzzle in Word Connections Master, the word game that trains you to see what is hiding between the words.

Every level places a group of words in front of you. Some seem completely unrelated. But look closer, and a connection begins to emerge. A hidden category. An association that was there all along, waiting for you to notice it.

🧩 HOW THE GAME WORKS
This word association game gives you a group of words and one goal: group them by their hidden connection. Four words per category. Multiple categories per level. Each correct association locks in. Each wrong guess makes you look again. The game never rushes you. It simply waits, patiently, for the moment the connection clicks.

And when it does? That feeling is unlike any other word game.

🔎 WHAT MAKES A CONNECTION?
In this game, associations come from everywhere. Sometimes the connection is a shared category, such as colours, animals, or countries. Sometimes it is a concept like: words that all follow something, or precede something, or describe the same feeling. Sometimes the association is so unexpected that you will stop and smile when you find it.

That is the magic of this word game. The connections are always logical. They are just not always obvious.

💡 WHAT YOU WILL DISCOVER
🔹Word associations you never knew existed
🔹Categories and connections that span language, culture, nature, and everyday life
🔹A new way of reading words, not just for meaning, but for the hidden relationship
🔹How much your vocabulary and general knowledge can surprise you
🔹That the most satisfying game moments come from connections you almost missed

🎯 WHAT THE GAME BUILDS
🔸Stronger word association skills with every puzzle you solve
🔸A richer vocabulary and deeper understanding of language
🔸Pattern recognition that sharpens the more you play
🔸A calmer, more curious way of approaching problems
🔸Confidence in finding connections where others see none

📦 WHAT IS INSIDE
🔹Hundreds of word association puzzles across dozens of unexpected themes
🔹A game that grows in depth the further you explore
🔹Progressive difficulty, early connections welcome you, later ones will make you wonder
🔹A gentle hint system that nudges without spoiling the association
🔹New word connections and game puzzles added regularly

apps.title: Candy Cannon Sort
apps.summary:
Aim. Fling. Watch the tubes ERUPT!

Candy Cannon Sort mixes ball sort with a bubble shooter. Instead of moving balls from tube to tube, you fire glossy candy balls from a cannon straight into glass tubes. Fill a tube with 4 balls of one color and it erupts in a geyser of rainbow confetti and clears.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag back and let go (or just tap a tube) to fling the loaded candy.
• Watch the chute: you can see the next balls coming, so plan ahead.
• 4 of one color in a tube = SWEET! The tube erupts and empties.
• Every eruption shakes the wrong balls off the neighboring tubes. They fly home into a matching tube or back into your cannon.
• Clear every color to win. Run out of room and the level is over.

WHY YOU'LL KEEP PLAYING
• Chain reactions: one good shot can set off SWEET, GREAT, AMAZING and SUGAR RUSH combos in a row, each one louder and bigger than the last.
• Big payoffs: rainbow confetti, candy rain and a LEVEL CLEAR party on every win.
• Quick levels: most take under a minute, and the next one starts right away.
• Over 1000 levels across five candy worlds: Lollipop Lane, Gumdrop Grove, Caramel Canyon, Bubblegum Bay and Minty Peaks.
• New twists keep coming: purple "?" Mystery Candy that only shows its color when it reaches the top, rainbow Jawbreakers, Tricky levels and Sweet Shot bonus levels that pay triple coins.
• Handy boosters: Undo, Hammer and Shuffle help you out of a tight spot.
• Juicy toy look: bright rainbow candy, shiny glass tubes and playful sounds.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Free to play. The game shows ads, and some rewards are unlocked by watching an optional ad.
• No in-app purchases.
• Play offline, no Wi-Fi needed for the puzzles.
• One finger is all you need.

Load the cannon, sort the candy and chase your sweetest chain in Candy Cannon Sort!
